jobs.title: Care Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Care team at GetYourGuide exists to make every interaction with our platform - for travellers, suppliers, and partners - feel effortless, trusted, and human. We sit at the intersection of customer experience, operational excellence, and business strategy, and we play a critical role in ensuring that the people who power our marketplace can thrive on it. From how we design our support channels to how we measure and improve satisfaction, Care is a strategic function that directly shapes GetYourGuide's reputation and growth.

Within Care, the Care Experience & Strategy team drives the thinking and direction behind how we support our stakeholders at scale. We translate company strategy into Care roadmaps, lead cross-functional initiatives that improve the experience of travellers, suppliers, and partners, and ensure that data and insight - not assumption - guide every decision we make. As Senior Strategy Lead for Partner Support & Success, you will be a  senior individual contributor , owning the strategic agenda for how Care serves and grows our supplier and partner relationships, with direct impact on stakeholder satisfaction and GMV.

Your mission

- Define and own a stakeholder segment of the Care strategy, starting with partner and supplier support and success -  setting the direction for how we engage, support, and grow these relationships, and translating company OKRs into a clear, prioritised Care roadmap

- Own the quarterly Voice of Partner process: further develop how we capture, synthesise, and act on partner feedback at scale, and ensure those insights create meaningful feedback loops into Product, Supply, and Care leadership

- Set and own partner target-setting - defining and tracking CSAT and other success metrics (e.g. GMV contribution, contact rate, resolution quality) on a yearly and quarterly basis; diagnose root causes and translate findings into strategic recommendations

- Lead the strategy definition for long-term, transformational projects in our partner support and success space - owning the vision, the business case, and the cross-functional alignment needed to move from ambition to roadmap

- Own specific high-impact programmes to operationalise our partner strategy - taking initiatives from definition through to delivery and measurable outcomes

- In your early months, lean into the supplier support space to absorb existing best practices and ensure they are effectively transferred and adapted for the partner context

- Influence collaborating teams across GetYourGuide - particularly Product and Supply - by representing the partner perspective in cross-functional forums and shaping decisions that affect partner experience upstream

- Leverage AI to accelerate strategic work : synthesise unstructured partner feedback, build custom workflows for insight capture and reporting, and actively drive AI adoption and capability-building across the Care team

- Identify structural gaps in how Care currently serves partners and turn them into roadmap-ready initiatives with clear business cases , success metrics, and stakeholder alignment

Your toolkit

- 7+ years of experience in strategy , customer success , or a related field in a fast-paced environment (e.g. marketplace, SaaS scaleup, consulting, or B2B platform); experience in global or multi-market contexts is a plus

- Proven track record of owning and delivering strategic programmes end-to-end - from problem definition through to measurable business impact

- Strong cross-functional influence skills : you can move senior stakeholders in Product, Supply, and commercial teams without direct authority, and build credibility through insight and rigour

- Analytically sharp and data-driven : you define KPIs, interrogate data, and build a clear narrative from both quantitative and qualitative signals

- Demonstrated experience as an AI Power User - you actively use AI for strategic synthesis and analysis, build your own workflows and automations, and help others in your team do the same; concrete examples of impact are a must

- Deep empathy for external stakeholders (suppliers, partners, customers): you are driven by improving their experience and can connect that to business outcomes like CSAT and GMV

- Excellent communication skills in English, written and verbal - you can tailor a strategic narrative for a frontline team and a VP in the same day

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity : you can structure messy problems, create clarity, and move teams forward without perfect information

Extras that give you an edge

- Background in customer success, partner success, or service design in a marketplace or platform environment

- Experience in online travel, e-commerce, or two-sided marketplace businesses

- Familiarity with support tooling and data platforms (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce, SQL/BI tools, CSAT measurement frameworks)

- Experience building or scaling a voice-of-customer or voice-of-partner programme

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

- Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

- Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

- A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

- Opportunities to collaborate and socialize  with a quarterly team event budget

- Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them

- Monthly transportation and fitness budget

- Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

- Language reimbursement program

- Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How to apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘ how we hire ’ and ‘ life at GetYourGuide ’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com .

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy and Operations — Partnerships
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

About the role

Strategic Partnerships is running a multi-vertical, multi-region portfolio with real scale ambitions. The channels are defined. The teams are in place. What's missing is the machine that makes it all repeatable, and the person obsessed with building it.

This is a role for someone who chooses hard problems over safe ones, who sees an under-built operating system and can't help but fix it, and who measures success by whether the org around them got faster, sharper, and more capable. You sit at the center of how Partnerships executes: owning the planning cadences, performance frameworks, cross-functional machinery, and analytical infrastructure that lets a lean team manage a complex portfolio without losing speed or discipline.

You'll work directly with the Head of Strategic Partnerships and lead the Operations team, translating direction into action and making sure nothing important falls between the cracks. The right person for this role gets energy from closing things - you don't hand off recommendations, you stay in the room until things are done.

Your mission

- We're building a repeatable, scalable operating system for Strategic Partnerships as we convert our pipeline into launched, multi-vertical distribution.

- You'll own the planning cadences, financial frameworks, execution machinery, and cross-functional coordination that let a lean team manage a complex portfolio without losing speed or discipline.

- You work directly with the Head of Strategic Partnerships, lead the Operations team, and own the core P&L and planning infrastructure.

- Own the GMV forecast and P&L accountability for the partnership channel. Build the forecasting model, track actuals, and maintain forecast accuracy within 5-7%.

- Translate data into investment decisions.

- Design and run the annual and quarterly planning cycles end-to-end. Set targets, cascade OKRs, build financial frames, and run QBRs. Own the output, not the facilitation.

- Build and maintain the operating system. Define the playbooks, checklists, readiness gates, and stage gates that channel teams use. Enforce hygiene and accountability.

- Lead the Operations team. Manage and develop 7+ people. Make hiring and performance decisions. Build commercial instincts in your team.

- Own strategic project execution. Take complex, ambiguous problems from framing through delivery. Unblock cross-functional dependencies. Don't escalate; solve.

- Drive CRM and pipeline discipline. Define stage definitions, enforce coverage ratios, maintain data hygiene. Educate and hold commercial teams accountable.

- Build channel economics models. Separate reported from incremental revenue. Reprice terms against measured floors. Model unit economics and guide investment decisions.

Your toolkit:

Must haves:

- 7-10+ years combining strategy and operations. Deep expertise in ops roles at marketplaces, platforms, or high-growth tech. The consulting foundation helps. The operational experience matters more.

- Owned a revenue or GMV forecast and been measured on it. You know what accountability to a number means.

- Owned an annual or quarterly planning cycle as the owner of output. You set targets, designed OKRs, and were responsible for the results.

- Runs CRM and pipeline as a discipline. You've defined stage gates, enforced coverage ratios, and held teams accountable to them.

- Understands partner and channel economics. You can separate reported from incremental, reprice terms, and build a channel P&L from scratch.

- Comfortable building and scaling forecast and unit economics models. You model scenarios, run sensitivity analysis, and pressure-test business cases in Excel.

- Led an operations or analytics team of 3 or more people. You've made hiring and performance calls that mattered.

- Cleared cross-functional dependencies you didn't own. You've unblocked projects by coordinating functions you don't manage.

- Uses AI tools to improve your work. You've used Claude, ChatGPT, or similar with concrete examples of impact.

Nice to have:

- Travel or experiences industry background

- Consulting background, then moved in-house

- SaaS RevOps experience

- Scaled teams from 0 to 10+

Your profile will not be considered if:

- Have never owned a forecast or quota

- Have only advised or facilitated with no output you were accountable for

- Have managed only 1-2 people or relied on "cross-functional influence" instead of direct reports

- Have used AI tools to do the work instead of to improve your thinking

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

- Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

- Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

- A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

- Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

- Monthly transportation and fitness budget

- Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

- Language reimbursement program

- Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How to apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘ how we hire ’ and ‘ life at GetYourGuide ’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com .

We optimize supply growth via multiple operational and product-led levers such as securing more availability, providing suppliers with tools and insights to maximize their growth, and rewarding the right supplier behaviors.

Team mission

The Strategy & Corporate Development team’s mission is to support the creation and execution of innovative strategies that will help GetYourGuide harness its competitive advantage. We have a seat at the table and are able to navigate between big picture views and an analytical mindset to enable our Management team to make optimal decisions to achieve our company's mission.

Based in the Berlin headquarters and reporting to the Director of Strategy & Corporate Development you will partner with senior leaders across the company and play a vital part in informing and shaping strategy discussions by conducting in-depth market and competitive research, develop strategy recommendations and support the company strategy process.
